text:
david: Heads up — planning a hotpatch migration for tenant "acme" during next change window. Target 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Requires a short exclusive lock on tenant_users (~90s) and a backfill of ~100k rows. Canary? rollback plan? @sre-oncall
anjali: ack, can we scope down the backfill by skipping deleted rows? that'll reduce lock time.
mike: if we can run backfill in streaming batches (5000 rows / txn) we can keep lock to alter stage only. backfill async after schema apply? :thumbsup:
carla: prefer include canary on a single shard (shard-3). will monitor qps and p99.
deploy-bot: Migration job created: mj-7821. Scheduled at 2765439999. Steps: 1) Lock, 2) Apply DDL, 3) Release lock, 4) Async backfill batches.
sre-oncall: please attach fallback commands. If we hit >2x p99, we abort and roll back to previous schema using logical swap.
david: fallback: run rollback script — psql -c "SELECT apply_ddl_rollback('mj-7821')". Also run featureflag off: `ff toggle acme:use_new_email=false`
carla: can we pin app deploy to v=2026.04.02-hotpatch-1 to avoid consumers reading new column early?
anjali: yes, pinning suggested. I'll add version pin in release notes and update canary route.
mike: we should add deploy-bot holdpoint after DDL success to verify telemetry for 5m. deploy-bot: add holdpoint ok?
deploy-bot: holdpoint added (5m) @david @carla.
liz: two quick asks: 1) add kludge to limit connection pool for tenant during migration; 2) ensure audit log writes to separate table to reduce contention.
david: noted. updating ops checklist and release note snippet.
carla: escape hatch command: `/deploy abort-migration mj-7821` and DB-level abort: psql -c "SELECT cancel_migration('mj-7821')". Keep both handy.
sre-oncall: will watch traces, if error rate >0.5% or CPU >85% we hit arc.
david: final plan: canary on shard-3, pin app version, holdpoint 5m, async backfill throttled at 200 rps, rollback scripts ready. Proceeding to schedule on change window. :rocket:
mike: :thumbsup: good to go.
carla: leaving note in release-notes channel and tagging infra-runbook.
deploy-bot: mj-7821 status: scheduled -> 2765440200
